in_sanskrit.name: देवद्युति
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: देव (Deva) - god द्युति (Dyuti) - light or lightning

in_hindi.name: देवद्यूति
in_hindi.meaning: देव (Deva) - देवता (Devata) - god द्यूति (Dyuti) - अग्नि (Agni) - fire; वज्र (Vajra) - lightning
in_hindi.long_meaning: देव (Deva) - देवता (Devata) - god द्यूति (Dyuti) - अग्नि (Agni) - अग्निदेव (AgniDeva) - god of fire वज्र (Vajra) - वज्रपानी (Vajrapani) - god of thunderbolt Therefore, Devadyuti can be considered as the god of both fire and lightning.

in_marathi.name: Devadyuti
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Dharma's divine weapon
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devadyuti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Deva (god) + Dātu (weapon, divine possession). The name 'Devadyuti' refers to the divine weapon of the god of dharma (righteousness).

in_bengali.name: Devadyuti
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Dharma's divine weapon
in_bengali.long_meaning: Devadyuti একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Deva (god) + Dātu (weapon, divine possession). The name 'Devadyuti' refers to the divine weapon of the god of dharma (righteousness).
